description.zh: 上下文仪表盘：把 Operit 每轮发给模型的提示词逐字落盘，并以可视化仪表盘呈现——统计、Token 构成、趋势、上下文浏览器、事件、文件活动、世界书。
description.en: Context Dashboard: captures the exact prompt Operit sends to the model on every turn, and visualizes it - stats, token composition, trends, context browser, events, file activity, worldbook.
